data.name: Caitrin
data.gender_notes: Caitrin is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Caitrin is an Irish name derived from the Old Irish word 'caithreim' meaning 'pure' or 'clean'. It was a popular name among the Celts and was often given to babies born in the springtime. The name Caitrin carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Caitrin usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Caitrin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Caitrin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קייטרין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קייטרין מקורו בשם העברי קטרינה, שפירושו טוהר וזיקוק הנפש לניקיון. השם נגזר מהמילה 'קתרוס', שפירושו טהור. השם קייטרין משמש כנראה כגרסה סלאבית של השם היווני Αικατερίνη, שגם הוא קשור למושג הטוהר והניקיון.

in_greek.name: Καίτριν
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Καίτριν εἶναι παραλλαγή τοῦ ονόματος Αἰκατερίνη, ποὺ προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸν ἑβραϊκὸ ὄρο καθαρότης. Ἡ Αἰκατερίνη συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἰδέα τῆς πνευματικῆς καθαρότητος καὶ τῆς ἀγιότητος. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, ὁ ὄρος καθαρός ἔχει μεγάλη σημασία ὡς σύμβολο τῆς πνευματικῆς ἀνανέωσης.

in_latin.name: Caitrin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Caitrin derivatur ex nomine Graeco Αικατερίνη, quod significat puritatem et sanctitatem mentis. In Ecclesia primitiva, conceptum puritatis habebat magnam vim spiritualem, sicut in Novo Testamento, ubi puritas mentis et cordis consideratur fundamentum vitae spiritualis.

in_english.name: Caitrin
in_english.meaning: Pure and clean spirit, clear conscience
in_english.long_meaning: The name Caitrin originates from the Greek name Αικατερίνη (Aikaterine), which means 'pure'. It is associated with spiritual purity and cleanliness of heart. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing the importance of inner purity and moral integrity. The name Caitrin is particularly popular in Celtic Christian traditions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Caitrin carries traces of the Celtic heritage and can evoke a feeling of purity, cleanliness, and a connection to the mythological past. It is a name that resonates with the rugged Irish landscapes and the rich cultural history of Ireland. It is a beautiful reminder that every new life brings freshness and renewal.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Caitrin lies in its meaning of purity and cleanliness, which is a reflection of the divine nature of God. It is a reminder that as humans, we are created in the image of God, and it is our spiritual duty to strive towards purity and cleanliness of heart and soul. The name Caitrin inspires us to live up to our highest potential and to seek out the divine presence within ourselves and in the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Caitrin, meaning pure or clean in Irish, symbolizes the commitment of a Christian to lead a life free from sin and devoted to God. It reflects the spiritual journey towards inner purity and the grace of the Lord in guiding one's path.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Hannah Caitrin in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Caitrin, which means "Pure, Clean". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
